reviews.text: Great doctors and good pricing. Dr Brennan is very knowledgeable and communicative.

They were really nice, attentive and focused on finding what was wrong with my dog. They didn’t follow up on the phone like they said they would. The facility also really needs a deep clean, though, it smells like it hasn’t been deep cleaned in a long time, which was gross. I would go back for the continuity of care and knowing I could get in, but there are many other options that are better.

There are plenty things to like about this vet: Weekend availability for appointments, friendly staff, reasonable prices.

There are also some very concerning things about this vet:
- Mixed messaging from the doctors.  One doctor said that the kidney values from blood test are not a big deal (slightly elevated). When calling back asking about food, another doctor evaluated the results and seemed much more concerned about the kidney results.
- Communication is great a times and horrible at times.  They will text you asking if you have any questions and to check in post surgery.  However I got a blood test that was needed pre-surgery and I was told we would get results next day.  4 days later I still had no update, and 30 min before close the day before the surgery I had to call in for the second time to get a status update.  I was simply just looking for an answer if he was good to go not even a comprehensive discussion.  They also will not call when dog is ready for pickup after surgery.  Rather they give a two hour time pickup window that they likely will be ready.  (you can call in at anytime to see the status of your dog but it would be really nice to just get a call/text when the animal is ready for pickup)
- Mismanagement of documents.  I had to send in records before first visit to get them up to speed.  A year later when we were back in they were requesting the same records again.

Honestly the downsides are not something to immediately disqualify the vet, but I am more so considering other options at this point.
Ok, very pricey, but ok

Wonderful service!! I have an anxiety ridden pit Belgian Malinois mix lol He can be aggressive with other dogs and males. Pearl street helped my visit be as comfortable as can be for Tony!  There has been times where I needed to bring my two legged kids with me too lol. The staff interacted with them so well. Keeping me and Tony as calm as can be ❤️

I believe his name was Josh. Absolutely amazing and very patient with my friend and i as we had to bring our frenchie in for a little check up. My friend was a little frazzled and basically let me take over the visit and i could tell Josh could sense that. He had no problem communicating with me in regards to our little guy. Amazing service. Definitely appreciate you Josh 😊 Thank you very much.
Overall good experience.

Absolutely love this place! Tried a few vets before we landed here. Here are a few reasons why we love Grand Animal Hospital:
* Open 7 days a week
* Open late every day
* The staff is super friendly
* They always get back to me asap
* I can always get an appointment

I would never recommend Grand Animal Hospital based on my experience.

I brought my dog in for a urine test and was told she had “crystals in her urine.” During the appointment, the veterinarian presented prescription food as the only option and made it sound like this was a significant issue that required immediate dietary intervention.

Something didn’t sit right with me, so I sought a second opinion. The second veterinarian reviewed the original report and found that it documented only a single crystal—not multiple crystals as had been implied to me. They also performed their own evaluation and confirmed that my dog does not currently have crystals in her urine and is perfectly healthy.

What is most concerning is that I felt pressured into purchasing a prescription diet without being given a complete picture of the results or informed of other possible explanations and treatment approaches. As a pet owner, I rely on veterinary professionals to provide accurate information and present all reasonable options, not use language that creates unnecessary fear or urgency.

This experience cost me time, money, and a great deal of unnecessary stress. Thankfully, I trusted my instincts and sought another opinion. I would encourage other pet owners to ask questions, request copies of test results, and consider a second opinion before making significant treatment decisions.

Prior to this incident, I have been taking my dog here for her 4 years. It makes me wonder what else we have been lied to about or conned into purchasing. The photo attached is the letter I received today giving me the great news that she is in the clear, no thanks to GAH.
My dog ate onion slices that I dropped while cooking. They treated her very quickly and were very respectful and professional. I am so grateful🙏 …

I was going to bring my Dog here and she unfortunately died before I could. The vet hospital was kind enough to write me a grievance card with all their staff writing something for my dog. We had never met these kind people but I will be giving them my business with my other remaining pets. No one in my personal life wrote me a grievance card and this meant a lot to me. Thank you very much.

They were able to help my dog on short notice, and I couldn’t be more appreciative. The veterinary staff was incredibly compassionate, attentive, and knowledgeable. They handled my dog’s situation with exceptional care and professionalism, and I’m truly grateful for the entire team.

Cannot recommend Grand Animal Hospital enough! They are very quick to respond and often can get you and your fur baby in in less than 24 hours. Dr. Brennan is very personable and works with you to make sure to get your pet the best but also affordable healthcare.

Thank you Grand Animal Hospital!
great vet. listens and treats. compassionate. reasonable prices, thank you, grand animal hospital.
Excellent veterinarians & staff, quality, top shelf care for my senior Min-Chi dog and great, timely availability for scheduling appointments.

I was referred to Grand by a friend. Was able to get a same day appointment on a weekend (which was amazing), but they were able to provide a prompt assessment of my dog and aid the pain at a moment's notice and did not break the bank! Not to mention everyone was extremely sweet and equally caring of my Husky Yukon and myself. I felt heard and valued. Thanks!!!
Such nice people, fare minded, and genuinely interested in the welfare of the animals they see. Greatnpart of the community

I had a great experience with Dr Venkat and the staff at Grand Animal Hospital. They were quick with their diagnosis and care plan, and my dog is doing well with her recovery from surgery. I would definitely recommend them to everyone!
Nice staff, clean environment, my dog is always well taken care there.
The vets and vet techs at Grand Animal Hospital take such good care of our cat.

Kind, thorough, caring veterinarians who have resolved every issue I’ve ever had with even my paralyzed puppy and special needs pup with a rare autoimmune disease.  The staff is knowledgeable and very friendly.  The hospital is clean and the atmosphere is pleasant.  Everything is always organized and inviting from the time I walk in the door.  Can’t say enough good things about this Veterinarian Hospital!!

Thank you!
W.S.

The treatment was most reasonable, my dog improved relatively quickly and was well enough to sneak some sniffs of the local delicacies Prices are very reasonable. Would certainly use their services in the future if needed.
Friendly staff, experienced vets, took and resolved my dog emergency immediately.

Dr. Brennan has excellent bedside manner. Very sweet and caring with my anxious pittie. Appreciated that they are upfront with all costs before taking action. Price matched the Simparica Trio which was great.

The love ,patience,attention we got during a difficult time was amazing, thank you carla, you are awesome !  my family and i truly apprciate all your attention and care you provided. Peluche 11.01.10-10-03-25 !
I have been going here with my dog Zeke for as long as I can remember! They are always so caring and helpful! Thanks for taking care of my dogs!

Dante decided it was time and this place was amazing. Accommodating,  pleasant, understood what I was dealing with and still managed to make it all quick and easy. Even let me spend time with my monster mutt for a while before I had to let him go. Highly recommend this place
Great vet hospital. Truly helped me with my extremely scared puppy.
They took excellent care of our beloved cat 😺😻😻 …
Karla was amazing with our little Lulu! We shall come back for further testing and vaccines ✨✨

I can’t say enough about the incredible care we received at Grand Animal Hospital. Late on a Friday afternoon, my cat was mauled by a dog, and the entire team immediately sprang into action. They got us in right away and began treatment without hesitation. Throughout the process, they provided frequent updates, which was incredibly reassuring during such a stressful time.

I especially want to highlight Selena, who truly went above and beyond. The cat’s owner does not speak English, and Selena stepped in to translate every detail of the diagnosis, treatment plan, and follow-up care. She was attentive, compassionate, and empathetic, exactly the kind of person any company should be proud to have on their team. Her professionalism and kindness made all the difference, and I’m deeply grateful for her help.

Grand Animal Hospital is lucky to have her, and so are their clients.

I took my 5 kittens there and they handled them all very quickly and efficiently, and they were able to get my two boys neutered the same day. They were also able to get us a really good deal on the whole visit. It’s a bit out of our way from home, but it’s worth it.
Took me as a walk in, examined my dogs eye boogers, hooked me up w meds and I was out in 20 minutes.  I luv simplicity...and reasonable rates. Thanks Grand Animal. Got a new vet now.
Dr. Brennan is great!!

My mom and I have been bringing our pets to this vet for over 20 years, and we’ve always had a great experience. I recently saw Dr. Venkat Donuru for both my dog and cat, and he was absolutely wonderful—compassionate, thorough, and incredibly informative. The staff here has always been phenomenal, consistently friendly and helpful. I’ve also had the pleasure of seeing Dr. Brennan in the past, and he’s just as fabulous. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic—they truly care about their patients and it shows!
Best veterinary office in Pacific Beach!
Great Doctor! Very attentive staff.

I have never written a review before, but this time I feel the need too. There was a doctor at this hospital that had prescribed my cat steroids for his asthma. He had been seen earlier this month for his asthma that they had originally reported to be bronchitis. I had called yesterday to ask them for a prescription of an albuterol inhaler for my cat because he was not doing very well and they had told me oh he’s fine just keep him in his meds and start at the beginning with the original doses and that the inhaler doesn’t work right and that she would call me back to talk about the prescription dose update. She did not call back. The next morning my roommate had found my cat lethargic mouth breathing and abdominal breathing and labored breaths and non responsive after following what the vet had said. He had to be taken to an emergency vet for bill over 2,500 dollars which could have been avoided if the prescription of the inhaler was given which my friend whom is a vet tech had stated. She had also stated that it was wrong for not giving an inhaler because of those asthma attacks. The vet tech I had talked to at the emergency vet also did not understand why he wasn’t prescribed for an inhaler. All of his breathing issues started after he had been tubed and put under general anesthesia for his neutering. He has aspirated during surgery and I was not made aware of that, or they hadn’t checked after words. The people there are nice yes, but they also had lacked in due diligence and were negligent towards my worries and the well being of my cat. Now he is currently in the hospital while I am out of state with a vet bill that could have been avoided if he was prescribed the right treatment. I had to be asked if I wanted to due CPR on my cat at the emergency vet if he had stopped breathing. That is something that has really messed with my head. I wish there was a 0 star rating because they had put my cat in danger.
I would find another Vet, they are only interested in gauging.
The best around. We drive from north county down to see them for every visit. Thats how great these guys are.
Quick to fill my request

Best vet in San Diego. The staff here is kind and accommodating, always ready to help in the event of an emergency or just for walk-in services. My dog has extreme anxiety at vet offices so we don't love coming to places like this, but they make it as easy as possible. There are plenty of vet offices closer to where I live, but I'll drive the extra 20-30 minutes because I appreciate this team and the care they provide. Thanks Grand Animal Hospital for taking care of my boy!
We Loved Selena, she was so caring and helpful with Boo I really appreciate her help….. I don’t love how expensive it’s gotten with the new owners….

I recently brought my senior pup here after a scary morning - we woke up to half her face swollen with no immediate known cause. I called her original vet (Cabrillo) who gave zero effort to get her in, no immediate concern, and quite frankly a full blow off. At the recommendation of a few friends I called Grand Animal Hospital - they got her in the same day, had an incredibly attentive and supportive team, and were very thorough with their evaluation. They advised a dental procedure the following week and treated my senior with such care - I am so impressed and will be recommending Grand to any of my friends and family in the area looking for top treatment of their pets. Finding a vet you trust is hard, but I am very confident that Grand is the best choice in the area.
So kind and caring when we needed help with our very sick kitty.

I recently took my dog in for his annual check-up, and I was very happy with the experience! Moving to a new state with a dog who had a pretty rare health condition made me nervous about finding the right veterinary care, but Grand made me feel at ease.

The staff was welcoming and took the time to listen to all of my concerns about my dog’s health and history. The vet was incredibly knowledgeable and thorough in his examination. I left feeling reassured and confident that we’ve found a quality, caring vet. It’s clear they truly care about their patients, and I couldn’t be happier with the care my dog received. I will be continuing my dog’s care here!

Grand Animal Hospital, specifically, Dr. Brennan told me that my dog had a nail that had to be pulled out because the nail was split. He was going to charge me over $200 for anesthesia, but said if it was loose, he could just pull the nail. He then just clipped the nail and put a band aid on it. This cost me over $200. When the bandage was removed, my dog still had her nail. So, Brennan lied to me and almost talked me into giving him over $400. This is not the first time this clinic has overcharged me. The idea that he lied is incredible. I even tried to get my money back and he refused. He said, "I never told you that the nail would be pulled." He did because that is why he mentioned the anesthesia. He even had me buy medicine for my puppy as if putting young dogs on drugs they don't need is healthy. I will never go back to this "Hospital."
Excellent care for affordable prices.
Always kind and caring, truly animal lovers. Fair and reasonable prices and excellent care

I brought my dog in a few times for some intestinal issues. In separate visits Dr. Yogesh and Dr. Brennan treated her. My dog is really anxious but they were both very gentle and patient with her. They took time to explain potential causes and treatment options. The quality of care was excellent. I’ll definitely bring my dog back here for any future treatment. Big thanks to Grand Animal Hospital!
We love Grand Animal Hospital. We have seen a few vets during our time going there over the years, but Dr. Brennan is the absolute best.  We’re so happy he’s there now!

I am so grateful to the doctors and nurses at Grand Animal!  I want to especially thank Nurse Jackie as well as Doctor Brennan.  I am a demanding pet mom and was hysterical when my fur baby was sick.  Jackie calmly talked me down and made me feel comfortable.  They had to do emergency surgery to remove 2 bags of plastic from my cat's stomach!  He is now healthy and back to his normal feisty cat self.
Nice people

The employees here are amazing. Super nice and don’t try to charge you for anything you don’t need. We took our dog in this morning for an emergency injury and they couldn’t have been more accommodating. I highly recommend Grand Animal Hospital for all your pet care needs.
